# Recording AI summary

Read and follow [the complete skill](../../../skills/recording-ai-summary/SKILL.md)
before authoring a summary.

Every run must ask for the local transcript path, then the local output folder,
then obtain approval of a detailed preflight plan. After generating and validating
the local draft, ask the user to review it. Do not skip these steps when paths
are already present in the prompt; follow the complete skill's intake rules.

Resolve all resources and generator commands relative to
`skills/recording-ai-summary/`, the canonical shareable package, not this entry.
